unsupported.reason: 不在官方提示的交付路径交付：模型 agent 在兄弟容器里、以上游自己的运行目录为 /workspace 工作，看不到交给系统的起始文件和交付路径；范式是起草评测器后优化一个标量、再写论文。证据：TBS symbolic-regression 的 regressor.py 与起始文件逐字节相同；SAB 92 冒烟里兄弟容器因 /workspace 重复挂载起不来（已修，修后交付仍不在交付路径）。维护者 2026-10-28 决定不花钱真跑（#77 方案 B）。
unsupported.reason_en: Does not deliver at the paths the official prompt names: the model agents work in sibling containers with upstream's own run directory as /workspace and never see the starting files or the deliverable paths; the paradigm drafts an evaluator, optimises a scalar and writes a paper. Evidence: in TBS symbolic-regression regressor.py stayed byte-identical to the starting file; in the SAB 92 smoke run the siblings did not start because of a duplicate /workspace mount (fixed; deliverables still not at the paths). Maintainer, 2026-10-28: not run (#77, option B).

unsupported.reason: 没有能用工具的 agent，是 23 段提示链：产出写在自己的 deliverables 目录，不在官方提示的交付路径；装包被关（PIP_NO_INDEX）；离线题的文献检索全部被拒、空 shortlist 会暂停。证据：TBS symbolic-regression 起始文件未改；SAB 92 冒烟 23 段跑完、交付缺失。维护者 2026-10-28 决定不花钱真跑（#77 方案 B）。
unsupported.reason_en: No tool-using agent, a 23-stage prompt chain: it writes into its own deliverables directory, not at the paths the official prompt names; package installs are off (PIP_NO_INDEX); for an offline item every literature search is refused and an empty shortlist pauses it. Evidence: TBS symbolic-regression starting file unchanged; the SAB 92 smoke run finished all 23 stages with the deliverable missing. Maintainer, 2026-10-28: not run (#77, option B).
